0.q: Treatment with 0.2 mM sodium tungstate rendered the SpCIPK26-OXP plants almost as susceptible to drought and salt stress as the WT plants, suggesting the tolerance of SpCIPK26-OXP plants to drought and salt stress was mediated, at least partly, by an ABA-dependent signaling pathway.

1.q: The levels of two key ROS (H2O2 and O2−) were lower in the transgenic plants at all time points, suggesting SpCIPK26 had a positive regulatory role during drought and salt stress responses.
